title: Plane Passing Through Three Non-Collinear Points
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the equation of the plane passing through the points A(1, 1, 1), B(2, 0, 3), and C(0, 2, 1).

steps.title: Construct Two Spanning Vectors in the Plane
steps.explanation: Form vectors connecting point A to B and C.
steps.why: Determining two vectors lying in the plane.

steps.title: Find Normal Vector via Cross Product
steps.explanation: Cross product of coplanar vectors is perpendicular to the plane. Dividing by -2 gives n = <1, 1, 0>.

steps.title: Formulate Plane Equation
steps.explanation: Substitute point A(1, 1, 1) and simplified normal <1, 1, 0>.
